items.followUp: Describe star topology and state one advantage.

rubric.why: Identifies that all computers connect to the bus, which is the main cable.
rubric.description: States the bus topology’s physical arrangement.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for explaining that all computers are connected to one main cable.

rubric.why: Explains how data travels along the bus to its intended computer.
rubric.description: Describes data transmission in a bus topology.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that data travels along the cable and the intended computer receives it.

rubric.why: Identifies that each computer connects to two others to form a closed loop.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for explaining that the computers form a closed loop, with each connected to two other computers.

rubric.why: Describes data passing from computer to computer around the ring until it reaches its destination.
rubric.description: Describes data transmission in a ring topology.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that data passes from one computer to the next around the ring to its destination.

modelAnswer: In a bus topology, all computers are connected to one main cable called the bus.
Data travels along this cable, and the intended computer receives it.
In a ring topology, each computer is connected to two other computers, forming a closed loop.
Data passes from one computer to the next around the ring until it reaches its destination.

items.followUp: Write two advantages of using pseudocode.

rubric.why: Identifies that a flowchart presents solution steps visually and makes them easier to understand.
rubric.description: Gives one advantage of a flowchart.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that a flowchart shows steps visually or makes them easier to understand.

rubric.why: Identifies that a flowchart helps communicate a solution.
rubric.description: Gives another advantage of a flowchart.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that a flowchart helps communicate the solution.

modelAnswer: A flowchart presents the steps of a solution visually, making them easier to understand.
It helps communicate the solution and can make errors easier to find before programming.

items.followUp: What is the purpose of the <head> tag in HTML?

rubric.why: Identifies the body as the section containing page content displayed in the browser.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the body contains the visible page content or content displayed in the browser.

rubric.why: Identifies the opening and closing body tags as the boundaries for the page content.
rubric.description: Explains how the body tag is used.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for explaining that page content is written between the opening and closing body tags.

modelAnswer: The <body> tag contains the content of an HTML page that is displayed in the browser, such as text and images.
This content is written between the opening <body> and closing </body> tags.
